# TRE™ in Singapore

> The Singapore hub for TRE™ (Tension and Trauma Releasing Exercises): certified providers, the Global TRE™ Provider Certification, workshops, online sessions and plain-language guides. Founded by Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer Isabelle Claus Teixeira. Website: https://tre-in-singapore.com/

TRE™ is a series of seven gentle exercises that safely activate a natural reflex: a shaking or vibrating response called a neurogenic tremor. Developed by Dr. David Berceli, the method helps the body release deep muscular patterns of stress, tension and trauma — without needing to talk about what happened.

TRE™ is a registered trademark of TRE For All, Inc. Method created by Dr. David Berceli.

## Guides and articles

- [Why the Body Shakes: The Science of Neurogenic Tremors](https://tre-in-singapore.com/blog/science-of-neurogenic-tremors): How self-induced neurogenic tremors relate to the stress response, the psoas and polyvagal theory: the science behind TRE™ trauma release exercises.
- [Your First TRE™ Session in Singapore: How to Prepare](https://tre-in-singapore.com/blog/your-first-tre-session): What to wear, what to expect and how to look after yourself before and after your first TRE™ session with a certified provider in Singapore.

- [Five Nervous-System Habits for Singapore's Workday](https://tre-in-singapore.com/blog/nervous-system-habits-for-the-workday): Practical nervous-system regulation habits for busy professionals in Singapore, informed by TRE™ (Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises) and somatic practice.
